metadata.purpose: Structures for the small-molecule members of guillain_barre_panel_v1, used as the known-chemical-matter reference set for novelty assessment in the de novo design campaign.
metadata.curation_rule: Every entry carries the molecular formula and average mass reported in the public literature for that agent. tests/test_chemistry.py re-derives both from the SMILES and fails on any disagreement. Each structure was additionally cross-checked against RDKit (formula and average mass); all 7 agree with both backends on the first transcription.
metadata.validation_limit: Structures were written from memory of the published skeletons. Formula and mass cannot detect a positional isomer, and methylprednisolone is entered without stereochemistry, which the connectivity-based novelty fingerprint does not read. Confirm each against a primary structure source before publication use.
metadata.why_this_file_exists: Without it, novelty for a Guillain-Barre design would be measured only against the pharmacophore library's own parent fragments. Registered before the first design run.
metadata.the_defining_limitation: This is the smallest reference set of the five diseases (7 structures), and for a structural reason: 9 of the panel's 16 agents are biologics or procedures with no small-molecule structure, including both approved disease-specific therapies (intravenous immunoglobulin and plasma exchange). Novelty is therefore measured against much less chemical matter than for any other disease, and the novelty figure a design earns here means correspondingly less.
metadata.omissions: Nine of the 16 panel records have no entry: intravenous immunoglobulin, its second-course record, plasma exchange, efgartigimod, imlifidase, eculizumab, tanruprubart, interferon beta-1a (all proteins or procedures) and 'C5aR antagonist (avacopan-class exemplar)', which names a chemotype rather than a settled structure and is omitted rather than guessed.
metadata.stereochemistry: Stereodescriptors are retained where the marketed agent is a single enantiomer (pregabalin). The fingerprint is connectivity-based and does not read them.
